answers.drew: My grandma a very well known Bolivian artist. She had a group with her siblings and got signed to a Brazilian label and constantly traveling throughout the continent. Seeing how she was so important in all Latin America, yet my country never showed any interest in them or supporting the arts, was the fuel and motivation I had to study music business and become the change they need.
